description: This file contains test functions for an asynchronous client-server application involving guardrail policies, API key management, and chat completion endpoints. It includes test cases for guardrail triggers, API key guards, team-based guardrails, load balancing, and error handling, primarily aimed at testing the behavior of the system in different guardrail scenarios.

methods.name: chat_completion( session, key, messages, model: Union[str, List] = "gpt-4", guardrails: Optional[List] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronous function to send a chat completion request to a local mock server with optional guardrails, returning the JSON response and response headers.

methods.name: generate_key( session, guardrails: Optional[List] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Asynchronous function to generate an API key with optional guardrails and team ID, sending a request to the local server.

methods.name: test_llm_guard_triggered_safe_request()
methods.description: Test to verify guardrails are not triggered when no guardrail should apply. Checks that the correct headers are present.

methods.name: test_llm_guard_triggered()
methods.description: Test to verify guardrail triggers a blocked response when PII or content violations are present.

methods.name: test_no_llm_guard_triggered()
methods.description: Test to verify no guardrails are applied when none are specified, ensuring headers reflect that.

methods.name: test_guardrails_with_api_key_controls()
methods.description: Test for API keys with and without guardrails, verifying responses and guardrail application behavior.

methods.name: test_bedrock_guardrail_triggered()
methods.description: Test to ensure bedrock guardrail triggers an exception when violated.

methods.name: test_custom_guardrail_during_call_triggered()
methods.description: Test to verify custom guardrail triggers an exception during a call.

methods.name: create_team(session, guardrails: Optional[List] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new team with specified guardrails, returning team info.

methods.name: test_guardrails_with_team_controls()
methods.description: Test for team-level guardrails, checking inheritance and trigger conditions.

methods.name: get_guardrail_lb_counts(session)
methods.description: Fetches load balancing call counts from the guardrail proxy.

methods.name: test_guardrail_load_balancing()
methods.description: Tests distribution of guardrail load balancing requests across multiple instances.

ctags.name: chat_completion
ctags.signature: ( session, key, messages, model: Union[str, List] = "gpt-4", guardrails: Optional[List] = None, )

ctags.name: generate_key
ctags.signature: ( session, guardrails: Optional[List] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None )
